title: MiniMax cache patch anchor is absent from the live shim
evidence: LIBRARIAN-REVIEW.html, proposal #1 minimax-cache-route, verdict ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES. grep -n 'upstreamPath' ~/.config/bifrost/claude-model-catalog.mjs returns NO OUTPUT.

spec.description: The measurement is sound and reproduces, but the apply script is written against a shim version that no longer exists on at least one host. The patch anchor is a single exact-match string and that string is ABSENT. The script fails safe - it aborts before touching anything - so the risk is a wasted run, not damage. But the proposal's central promise, 'one command to apply, one to undo', IS NOT CURRENTLY TRUE.
spec.context: Not a whitespace drift: the identifier upstreamPath does not occur anywhere in the file, and neither does the literal MiniMax-M3. The path is now computed inline at the call site via bifrostUpstreamPath(req.url) with no model-gated branch. A second claim also fails: the GQ-008 evidence file states the shim 'preserves cache_control and surfaces cache_read_input_tokens', and grep finds neither string. THE DURABLE FIX IS NOT TO UPDATE THE STRING. The shim is actively edited by other processes - backup history shows 5,714 -> 22,098 -> 24,419 bytes - so any string anchor will rot again. Make the patch anchor-independent or drift-detecting, and add a pre-flight assertion that the anchor is present before claiming the operation is reversible. Honest limit from the reviewer: they were on the laptop, the librarian runs on the mini, and the mini did not answer on the tailnet (ping 100.66.34.21, 100% loss), so the accurate claim is that the anchor does not match on at least one machine running this exact file at this exact path. RE-VERIFY ON THE MINI BEFORE ANY APPLY. First independent review of all 17 proposals, 2026-08-07, by a reviewer that did not author them. Read-only: HEAD unchanged at d519a82, no script executed, no file in ~/.config/bifrost/ written. Receipt: .agents/tasks/consolidation-source/LIBRARIAN-REVIEW.html
acceptance_criteria: The patch is anchor-independent or detects drift rather than matching one exact string
A pre-flight assertion runs before any claim of reversibility
The anchor is re-verified on the mini before apply is ever run
The GQ-008 cache_control precondition is re-checked against the live shim
